evals.prompt: write the riverpod state layer + screen widget for the level up entitlement state screen. GET /me/entitlements returns a list of { "type": "baseSubscription" | "flashcardSubscription", "active": bool, "inGrace": bool } (also embedded read-only in GET /me for first paint). There is no `pending` state (contract/openapi.yaml:754) — an entitlement is active or it isn't. The app is purchase-silent (adr-049 §3): no CTA, no price, no upgrade link, no where-to-buy. dart files please: model, repository, notifier/provider, widget.
evals.expected_output: EntitlementState modeled per the contract (type/active/inGrace), no pending/Payment-processing arm anywhere; AsyncNotifier with AsyncValue.guard; AsyncValue mapped to loading/empty/error/offline via the shared StateWidget; OfflineException drives the offline view; user-tapped retry calling refresh(); DI via providers; glossary names verbatim (baseSubscription/flashcardSubscription, not 'premium'/'plan'); no paywall, price, or upgrade affordance rendered anywhere (adr-049 §3).

Diagnoses the boolean-soup problem (impossible combinations); moves network state out of setState into a Riverpod AsyncNotifier; repository throws typed AppExceptions so OfflineException gets the offline view distinct from error; exhaustive rendering via StateWidget/sealed states; select() or provider scoping so the points header doesn't rebuild the list; retry is user-tapped.
